Name: adaptive_block_size
Title: Adaptive Block Size: Dynamic Context Window Adjustment for Efficient Training
Experiment: Modify the model to dynamically adjust its block size during training, starting with a smaller block size and gradually increasing it. This could potentially lead to faster initial training and better long-range dependency learning.

Name: layerwise_learning_rates
Title: Layer-wise Learning Rate Adaptation: Optimizing Training Dynamics in Transformer Models
Experiment: Implement layer-wise learning rates, where each transformer layer has its own learning rate. Modify the configure_optimizers function to assign different learning rates to different layers, with deeper layers having lower learning rates. Compare the training dynamics, convergence speed, and final performance with the baseline model.

Name: token_category_bias
Title: Token Category Attention Bias: Dynamic Importance Adjustment Based on Token Groups
Experiment: Modify the attention mechanism in the CausalSelfAttention class to introduce a learnable bias term for predefined token categories (e.g., punctuation, whitespace, alphanumeric). During training, these biases will dynamically adjust the attention weights of tokens belonging to each category. Analyze the learned biases post-training, evaluate their impact on training efficiency and validation loss, and compare the results with the baseline model. Visualize token category biases to interpret their significance.

Name: adaptive_positional_scaling
Title: Adaptive Positional Scaling: Lightweight Content-Aware Adjustments for Transformer Positional Embeddings
Experiment: Modify the forward method of the GPT class to include a token-level scaling factor applied to positional embeddings. Calculate scaling factors dynamically based on token statistics (e.g., mean or variance of token embeddings across the sequence). Compare validation loss and qualitative results (e.g., coherence in generated text) with the baseline model. Visualize the scaling factors to interpret their behavior and impact.
